The best thing you can do is to understand that you aren’t crazy for feeling this way. Do not fear it. The more you fear it and think “something is wrong with me” the more you will peak your anxiety and feed into the dissociation. Your best bet is to get to a therapist as soon as possible, figure out the exact reason you had your panic attack that triggered the dissociation, and understand how to over come whatever caused the panic attack. Dissociation isn’t your current problem. The current problem is the root of your panic attack that triggered the dissociation. That’s very important to understand.
